statement: ∀ Q : LR.Residue p K, letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra; ∃ G : LR.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[LR.R p] LR.MR p M, LR.GammaPure p K M Q.phi G ∧ (∀ (F : Module.End ℤ M) (z : LR.VK K M), G (F.baseChange K z) = ((F.baseChange (LR.R p)).baseChange K) (G z))
proof:
intro Q
letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
let G : LR.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[LR.R p] LR.MR p M := (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange ℤ (LR.R p) K K M).symm
refine ⟨G, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
· intro c m
  exact TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange_symm_tmul _ _ _ _ _
· intro c r m
  change (r • c) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m = _
  rfl
· intro F z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul c m => simp [G]
  | add z w hz hw => simp [hz, hw]
